en: Glass is an amorphous solid lacking a crystalline structure, debunking the myth that old windows are thicker because glass slowly flows.
When iron rusts, the resulting reddish flake actually weighs more than the original metal because it absorbs oxygen from the air.
The metal gallium melts at 29.7 degrees Celsius, meaning it turns into a liquid pool when held in a bare hand.
If ice were denser than liquid water, lakes would freeze from the bottom up and kill all aquatic life during winter.
A mixture of cornstarch and water acts as a hard solid when you punch it but flows like a liquid when poured.
Plasma is the most abundant state of matter in the universe, making up over 99 percent of all visible stars and space.
When baking soda and vinegar react in an open bowl, the mixture loses total mass because the newly formed carbon dioxide gas escapes.
Water striders walk on ponds because surface tension forces water molecules at the top to stick tightly together like an invisible elastic skin.
Mayonnaise is a stable emulsion where egg yolk forces tiny droplets of liquid oil and vinegar to mix without separating.
Solid carbon dioxide, commonly called dry ice, sublimates directly into a cold white fog without ever melting into a liquid puddle.
Silica aerogel is 99.8 percent air, making it an incredibly light solid material that can rest delicately on a flower petal.
Glow sticks produce light through chemiluminescence, a specific chemical reaction that releases energy as visible photons instead of generating dangerous heat.
